# Vojta Maur

> Static personal archival website of Vojta Maur. The site contains artistic projects, exhibition documentation, travel records, machine-readable text exports, archive metadata, and technical documentation for preserving or reconstructing the website.

This website is built as a static Astro project. The Czech content is the source of truth. English pages are generated as a derived static artifact after the build. If exact wording, titles, dates, or conceptual phrasing matter, prefer the Czech originals. Use English pages for general orientation when available.

This file intentionally uses relative links so the same build can work on the main domain, mirrors, and archival copies.

## Primary sources

* [Documentation](/documentation/): Technical documentation of the website architecture, project structure, Astro build modes, content model, translation workflow, public asset handling, deployment, and reconstruction logic.
* [All posts text export](/ALL_POSTS.txt): Plain-text export of article content. Best first source for LLM reading, full-text search, indexing, offline reading, and textual recovery if HTML, CSS, JavaScript, or the original build system becomes unusable.
* [Archive metadata](/ARCHIVE.txt): Archive metadata, entry points, mirrors, snapshots, source locations, build information, and preservation-related records.
* [Sitemap](/sitemap-index.xml): Canonical sitemap for the main public website. On mirrors, this file may still contain canonical `vojtamaur.cz` URLs.

## Main website sections

* [Homepage](/): Main entry point of the website.
* [Volná tvorba](/volna-tvorba/): Free artistic work, experiments, systems, structures, and conceptual projects.
* [Výstavy](/vystavy/): Exhibition documentation and related works.
* [Cestování](/cestovani/): Travel records, photographs, and videos.
* [English homepage](/en/): Generated English version of the website.
* [Technical documentation](/documentation/): Main technical reference for understanding, rebuilding, and preserving the project.

## Interpretation notes

* The website contains text, images, PDFs, videos, embedded media, and standalone demos.
* Non-textual material may be represented only by placeholders in `/ALL_POSTS.txt`; use the rendered website or source repository for the full media context.
* Some older legacy dates may be technically normalized during migration and should not always be interpreted as exact historical publication dates.
* Archive and mirror information should be read from `/ARCHIVE.txt` instead of being duplicated here.
* The website is designed for long-term preservation, redundancy, migration, and reconstruction rather than only ordinary web presentation.
